mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOOK_ITEM bi JOIN BOOK b ON bi.BOOK_ID = b.BOOK_ID WHERE b.TITLE = #{title} AND bi.STATUS = '대여가능'

SELECT bi.ITEM_ID FROM BOOK_ITEM bi JOIN BOOK b ON bi.BOOK_ID = b.BOOK_ID LEFT JOIN RENT r ON bi.ITEM_ID = r.ITEM_ID WHERE b.TITLE = #{title} AND bi.STATUS = '대여가능' GROUP BY bi.ITEM_ID ORDER BY COUNT(r.RENT_ID) ASC, bi.ITEM_ID ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY
